method: Isolated same-machine original-main and changed-code installs with independent frozen dependencies. AST wrappers time each callback and record shared AsyncLocalStorage lease ownership at entry. Durations exclude acquisition, queue waits and release overhead; inclusive nested spans must not be summed. All paths use explicit test files through the shared gate and owned runner. Original unlocked facades map to observed downstream commit bodies; their pooled samples include other callers. Failed-first cases intentionally inject competing changes, child admission and 400 ms writer holds. Numbers describe these fixtures, not production percentiles.
bodyOrder: Each body is identified by repository-relative file, enclosing function, and lexical ordinal in the original main inventory. Original line numbers identify the observation baseline. Renamed and removed bodies explicitly map to changed-code commits.
optionalSeams: The retained withImageAdmissionLock dependency hooks have no production caller and were not supplied by the after fixtures. Their production accountMutationWrite commits are measured instead.
